end_script.label: End script
end_script.description: Ends the script immediately. Unlocks the player if they were locked.

lock_player.label: Lock player
lock_player.description: Prevents map movement until unlock_player runs (or the script ends).

wait_frames.label: Wait frames
wait_frames.description: Waits for n engine frames before advancing to the next action.

args_help.n: Integer number of frames to wait (>= 0).

show_message.label: Show message
show_message.description: Shows overlay text. In the map viewer, the player dismisses with Q or Space.

args_help.text: Message string shown in the overlay.

close_message.label: Close message
close_message.description: Clears the message overlay without waiting for player input.

set_flag.label: Set flag
set_flag.description: FEATURE-MAP-072: Sets a persistent game-state flag (saved to save/game_state.json). Use the flag/variable registry to declare flag names.

args_help.name: Flag name string (declare it in the flag registry).

clear_flag.label: Clear flag
clear_flag.description: FEATURE-MAP-072: Clears a persistent game-state flag by name (saved to save/game_state.json).

unless_flag.label: Unless flag (skip N)
unless_flag.description: If the named flag is false, skips the next skip actions (relative skip count).

args_help.name: Flag to test.
args_help.skip: How many following actions to skip when the flag is false.

if_flag.label: If flag (block)
if_flag.description: Runs the actions in this block (up to the matching End if) only when the named flag is set. The skip count is computed automatically on load; you do not set it by hand.

args_help.name: Flag to test; the block runs when this flag is true.
args_help.skip: Auto-computed body length; managed by the editor and engine. Leave unset.

end_if.label: End if
end_if.description: Marks the end of an If flag block. Inserted/managed automatically by the block editor.

repeat.label: Repeat (block)
repeat.description: Repeats the actions in this block (up to the matching End repeat) n times. The skip count is computed automatically on load; you do not set it by hand.

args_help.n: Number of times to run the block (integer >= 0; 0 skips the block).
args_help.skip: Auto-computed body length; managed by the editor and engine. Leave unset.

end_repeat.label: End repeat
end_repeat.description: Marks the end of a Repeat block. Inserted/managed automatically by the block editor.

warp_player.label: Warp player
warp_player.description: Loads another map and places the player at tile (x, y). Ends the script. If mapId appears in world_layout.json, opens Overworld at map-local (x,y) on that instance.

args_help.mapId: Target map id (filename stem under src/maps).
args_help.x: Destination tile X (map-local anchor tile, same space as warp_player).
args_help.y: Destination tile Y. Runtime may snap to the nearest in-bounds walkable anchor.

set_player_facing.label: Set player facing
set_player_facing.description: Sets the trainer walk sprite facing row in the map viewer from a direction string (up/down/left/right aliases include north/south/east/west).

args_help.dir: One of: up, down, left, right (also north, south, west, east, n, s, w, e).

walk_to_coords.label: Walk (direction + steps)
walk_to_coords.description: FEATURE-MAP-071: Blocking rail movement — moves the player exactly `steps` tile strides along the specified cardinal `direction`. Movement is strictly along that axis; the script does not advance until all steps complete or a blocked footprint is hit (early finish). If `faceFirst` is true (default), the player is turned to face `direction` before the first step — useful for turn-only (steps:0) or turn-then-walk patterns. Set `faceFirst` to false for walk-only or walk-then-turn chaining after an explicit face_* opcode.

args_help.direction: Cardinal direction to walk: up/down/left/right (also north/south/west/east, n/s/w/e).
args_help.steps: Number of tile strides to move. 0 with faceFirst:true produces a turn-only with no movement.
args_help.faceFirst: Face the direction before the first step (default true). Set false to walk without re-facing, e.g. after an explicit face_* opcode.

run_to_coords.label: Run (direction + steps)
run_to_coords.description: FEATURE-MAP-071: Same rail movement as walk_to_coords but uses a faster walk animation timing (half the per-segment frame duration) for the duration of the opcode. Accepts the same direction/steps/faceFirst arguments.

args_help.direction: Cardinal direction to run: up/down/left/right (also north/south/west/east, n/s/w/e).
args_help.steps: Number of tile strides to move.
args_help.faceFirst: Face the direction before the first step (default true).

face_north.label: Face north
face_north.description: Sets player facing to north (up) without moving. Not blocking beyond one frame.

face_south.label: Face south
face_south.description: Sets player facing to south (down) without moving.

face_east.label: Face east
face_east.description: Sets player facing to east (right) without moving.

face_west.label: Face west
face_west.description: Sets player facing to west (left) without moving.

move_camera.label: Move camera
move_camera.description: Blocking: pans the view by shifting the camera follow offset one map tile per step in the given direction. Between steps, waits `speed` engine frames (0 = one tile per frame). Resets when the script ends.

args_help.steps: How many tile steps to pan (integer >= 0).
args_help.speed: Frames to wait after each step before the next (>= 0); 0 advances one step per engine frame.

camera_zoom_in.label: Camera zoom in
camera_zoom_in.description: Multiplies map/overworld draw tile scale (clamped). Not animated; advances immediately.

camera_zoom_out.label: Camera zoom out
camera_zoom_out.description: Divides map/overworld draw tile scale (clamped). Not animated; advances immediately.

camera_follow_player.label: Camera follow player
camera_follow_player.description: Clears script-driven camera tile offset from move_camera, stops an in-progress scripted pan, and re-syncs the map/overworld camera to follow the player (same clamping as after scripted walks). Does not reset camera_zoom_in/out scale.

set_var.label: Set variable
set_var.description: FEATURE-MAP-077: Assigns a scratch variable (int/string/bool) in the current scope. Scratch variables are NOT persisted; they last only for the current script run (or call frame for subflow locals).

args_help.name: Variable name.
args_help.value: Value to assign (number, string, or boolean).

if_var.label: If variable (block)
if_var.description: FEATURE-MAP-077: Runs the actions in this block (up to the matching End if var) only when the comparison holds. The skip count is computed automatically on load.

args_help.name: Variable to test.
args_help.skip: Auto-computed body length; managed by the editor and engine. Leave unset.

end_if_var.label: End if var
end_if_var.description: Marks the end of an If variable block. Inserted/managed automatically by the block editor.

call_subflow.label: Call subflow
call_subflow.description: FEATURE-MAP-074: Runs a named subflow like a method and returns to the caller when it finishes. Resolves an in-file subflow first, then a library connector under src/maps/scripts/_library/. Named args in `vars` seed the callee's local scratch variables. Recursion is depth-guarded.

args_help.name: Subflow name (in-file subflow or library connector).
args_help.vars: Optional object of named arguments that become the callee's local variables.

stop_script.label: Stop script
stop_script.description: FEATURE-MAP-075: Ends the entire script immediately, even inside a subflow. Unlocks the player if locked.

goto.label: Go to label
goto.description: FEATURE-MAP-075: Jumps to a label within the current flow and continues executing below it. Unknown labels are a safe no-op. Choose the target from the dropdown of labels in this flow.

args_help.label: Name of a label opcode in the current flow.

label.label: Label
label.description: FEATURE-MAP-075: Named jump target for goto. No runtime effect on its own.

comment.label: Comment
comment.description: FEATURE-MAP-076: A note for organization only. Not an action; has no runtime effect.

region.label: Region (block)
region.description: FEATURE-MAP-076: Organization-only collapsible/nestable marker. Groups and (in the editor) collapses the steps inside it. Has NO control-flow effect — the engine simply skips it.

end_region.label: End region
end_region.description: Marks the end of a Region block. Inserted/managed automatically by the block editor.

set_route_music.label: Set route music
set_route_music.description: Changes looping route BGM to a track under src/audio/.

play_music_once.label: Play music once
play_music_once.description: Plays a music track once (no loop).

start_trainer_battle.label: Start trainer battle
start_trainer_battle.description: Starts a scripted trainer battle; script yields until battle ends.
